title: Peacock reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='15' ry='19' fill='#1a6fbf'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#4fa3e0'/>

  <path d='M57 26 L66 28 L57 30 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>

  <circle cx='54' cy='24' r='2' fill='#ffffff'/>

  </g>
  <!-- feather eyes -->
  <circle cx='10' cy='22' r='4' fill='#9b59b6'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='22' r='1.8' fill='#ffd23f'/>

  <circle cx='6' cy='44' r='1.8' fill='#ffd23f'/>

  <circle cx='90' cy='22' r='4' fill='#9b59b6'/>
